name: Days to Nights
source:
You are a mysterious drifter who winds up in the small town of Possum Springs. You finds yourself among a group of friends who seem keen to let him into their social circle, but seem to be hiding something.

A Night in the Woods fan game based vaguely off of Snoot Game. 

[From [url=https://epyc-games.itch.io/days-to-nights]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一位神秘的漂流者，最终来到了负鼠泉小镇。你发现自己身处一群朋友之中，他们似乎热衷于让他进入他们的社交圈，但似乎在隐瞒什么。

《林中之夜》粉丝游戏大致基于《Snoot Game》。

[来自[url=https://epyc-games.itch.io/days-to-nights]Itch.io[/url]]
